_brief: Item 12, Phone Call Video / Tel Aviv. Compilation of the MOST INSPIRING answers. V4 after Tal on V3 (2026-10-04): 'I'd like maybe more inspiring answers... you can choose different answers' (he pointed at the cancer survivor's story as the kind of thing he means). Nine people, no light answers: opens on the phone being picked up with the sign readable, then 'if you're having a hard day... just look up'; the older man 2nd; 'my mom is the strongest woman I know' 4th; ends on 'every morning that we wake up and breathe, that makes us happy... love you'. Out: the Colombian visitor's 'Israel makes me happy' (V3's hook). In, new: 'look up', 'be kind', 'every morning we wake up and breathe', and the woman in the black cap's 'doing good for people' - on HER, because it is her voice (V2 showed her partner over it). NO ZOOMS: one static framing per shot.
_blur: EK_HAPPY_TELAVIV_COMP_V4.mp4 = the _BUILD render + blur-face.py with blur-rules.json: the small child with the pink bag who walks in behind the 'be kind' woman (profile for a few frames).
_framing: The couple are two separate static framings of one take: her line framed on her (3.0x, so a child passing behind them stays out), then his own line framed on him (2.67x, two boys stand at his elbow). The older man is at 2.0x and starts on 'seeing people happy' (a girl walks past during 'what makes me happy'). The woman in the headwrap starts on 'the best in the world' (a passer-by's back fills the frame under 'a person's happiness'). The opening pick-up starts once a man carrying a child has left the frame, so the handset is already in her hand, rising to her ear.
